alex: Morning — quick flareboard check. Can we get a 5-min snapshot on launch-posts performance vs last week? Any dashboard anomalies?
maria: Noticed CTR on launch post #3 up 18% MoM, but conversions down. looks like a landing mismatch. :thinking_face:
jordyn: I think the UTM landing param got dropped in the campaign redirect. saw 302 -> 200 chain in the logs. filing a docs PR to lock the redirect.
sam: Can you paste the redirect rule? I want to check inbound routing to Salesforce.
emily: Pasting dashboard link: https://redwood.dash/flareboard/launchsigs — look at cohort "post-3" > last 7d. Query we used: `SELECT source, utm_campaign, count(*) as hits FROM events WHERE event='landing' GROUP BY 1,2`
maria: Also flagging an attribution delta: GA4 shows last-touch while our pipeline uses weighted-last-touch. that's causing the conversion mismatch.
ajex: @maria (typo) — good point. can we run a backfill compare table? sam, can you run the export to S3?
sam: On it. Starting export job now: `aws s3 cp --recursive s3://internal-exports/flareboard/tmp .` ETA ~10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: If export looks clean, let's run a diff on `campaign_id` counts and then reconcile mapping for post ids.
jordyn: For messaging iteration: the A/B headline test is trending toward variant B for CTR but variant A for demo signups. I'd recommend we hold and push a small copy tweak to the CTA for variant B.
emily: I'll update the dashboard to surface signups per headline variant + funnel conversion. small note: slack alert automation to PMs if signup rate dips below 2%
mkt-bot: Weekly KPI digest posted: launches: sessions +12%, conversions -3%, pipeline influence +8%. See /threads/1769991230 for details.
alex: OK good thread. Action items: (1) sam run/confirm export + put results in #marketing-data, (2) jordyn change redirect rule & PR, (3) emily add variant funnel panels, (4) maria run attribution delta table and share quick memo. Back in 24h for status check-in. :thumbsup:
